cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments to cover! Put 'cross-department lead' on my schedule, please. We should record the expanded remit accurately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. A rotating departmental presence, not borrowed space. List each room under my remit, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Label the trolley with all three departments, please. Full names; I don't want the extent of my influence abbreviated.
